en:
The phone game I was playing is having a collab
with an anime I like...and I'm missing it...
<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Tsumugi for a while?

Collabs in phone games have been done to death,
so I don't like them that much, but...

I get happy when my favorite work gets one...
That's how they get whales to spend so much!

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some time carefully listening
to Tsumugi discuss her favorite anime.
<CLT=cltMIND>Tsumugi and I grew a little closer today.
